name: combine_header
source: The cutting header of a self-propelled combine harvester. It touches nothing: no draft, no soil force, no depth (kind applicator). It cuts while switched on over workable ground, moving forward; the width comes from the model's two work sockets, the mass from the vehicle. What the header takes (grain, straw) comes from the game's field model, the tank and the unloading belong to the game.

range.source: [AS] Usual combine working speeds 4-8 km/h in a cereal crop (manufacturer ranges, not read from a standard); above 8 km/h the header loses crop in front of the cutter bar and the feed becomes uneven, 0.07 per km/h to a floor of 0.5.

pto.source: [AS] The machine's threshing, separating and cleaning, on the combine's own shaft. Class figures: a 200 kW combine handles roughly 30-40 t/h of grain. no_load_kw 40 for what turns with nothing going through (a fifth of that power, a usual figure for drum, rotors, fans and chopper). specific_energy_kj_kg 17.5 = 4.86 kW per t/h, so 33 t/h takes 200 kW; the flow is the grain's, the straw that comes with it is inside the figure. inertia [AS] for drum and rotors referred to the shaft. min_speed_fraction [AS]: below half speed the separator loses grain and quality falls in proportion.
